mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in the federal funds rate compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS declines month-over-month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 6.5% with monthly increase exceeding 0.05 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings expectations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month increases in housing starts and retail sales indicate robust consumer demand, boosting corporate revenue expectations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where both HOUST and RSAFS increase month-over-month, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime (defined by declining industrial production), reduced manufacturing output lowers corporate profit margins, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1600 thousand units signal strong residential construction activity, indicating a robust economic expansion and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where HOUST exceeds 1600.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in industrial production and employment indicate expanding manufacturing and labor market strength, boosting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where both INDPRO and PAYEMS increase month-over-month, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (defined by rising federal funds rate), higher borrowing costs reduce corporate investment and consumer spending, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in industrial production indicates expanding manufacturing output, boosting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where INDPRO increases month-over-month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
